changes.rationale: Let merged task history leave the tree, and fix friction the first runs under the new tiers reported. One gate is loosened on purpose: handoff's 'task history deleted' and gaps --base's 'transition history changed or deleted' now accept a deletion when harness/archive.json lists the path and its commit holds the same blob the base did; an unlisted path, a listed path the commit lacks or holds in another version, a commit the repository does not have, and a changed receipt are still refused (xtask/src/archive.rs, pinned by archived_history_may_be_deleted_and_nothing_else). harness/archive.json joins the protected files in transitions.rs and scripts/agent-hook.sh, so adding to it needs a receipt. Nothing else is weakened. xtask check also writes its report to target/verification/PROFILE.json and adds output_tail to a check that did not pass; the report's existing fields are unchanged. A complete record may omit remaining; a partial one without it is refused with a message naming the field. The standard pages' length rule becomes a 20 KB file limit that task-artifact next reports as advice; completion does not read it. A late-brief error on a merge commit without --head says to pass it. scripts/agent-complete.sh treats other local branches like other remote ones when finding where this branch's own commits start, so a stack that was never pushed is judged per branch; HARNESS_BASE still overrides. size.rs and agent-artifact-write.sh messages say brief and before-code pages. harness/readiness.json lists the new tests under completion, task-artifacts and evidence. AGENTS.md, docs/COMPLETION.md and docs/READINESS.md drop the mkdir and redirect that failed in a fresh clone.
